description.zh:
消息通知内容的编码方式。取值范围：

- PlainText：不编码，采用明文传输。
- Base64：Base64 编码。

默认值：Base64。

> 仅支持MNS通知对象设置该参数。
description.en:
The encoding method for the notification content. Valid values:

- PlainText: no encoding. The content is transmitted in plaintext.
- Base64: Base64 encoding.

Default value: Base64.

> This parameter is supported only for MNS notification recipients.

description.zh:
通知对象标识符，设置本参数时支持以下通知方式：

- 云监控，参数取值格式：`acs:ess:{region-id}:{account-id}:cloudmonitor`。
- MNS队列，参数取值格式：`acs:mns:{region-id}:{account-id}:queue/{queuename}`。
- MNS主题，参数取值格式：`acs:mns:{region-id}:{account-id}:topic/{topicname}`。

参数格式中的变量含义如下：
- `region-id`：伸缩组所在的地域的ID。
- `account-id`：阿里云账号ID。
- `queuename`：MNS队列的名称。
- `topicname`：MNS主题的名称。
description.en:
The identifier of the notification recipient. The following notification methods are supported:

- CloudMonitor. Format: `acs:ess:{region-id}:{account-id}:cloudmonitor`.
- MNS queue. Format: `acs:mns:{region-id}:{account-id}:queue/{queuename}`.
- MNS topic. Format: `acs:mns:{region-id}:{account-id}:topic/{topicname}`.

The variables in the format are described as follows:
- `region-id`: the region ID of the scaling group.
- `account-id`: the Alibaba Cloud account ID.
- `queuename`: the name of the MNS queue.
- `topicname`: the name of the MNS topic.

description.en: One or more types of Auto Scaling event and resource change notifications. Valid values of N: 1 to 8. Specify multiple values in a repeated list format.
The region ID of the scaling group.
The ID of the scaling group.

description.zh:
消息通知的时区。
时区相对于协调世界时的偏移量： 如 UTC+8（东八区）、UTC-7（西七区）等。
description.en: The time zone for message notifications. The time zone is expressed as an offset from Coordinated Universal Time (UTC), such as UTC+8 or UTC-7.

title.zh: 创建弹性伸缩事件及资源变化通知
title.en: Create Auto Scaling event and resource change notifications

descriptions.zh:
## 接口说明

- 您可以设置由云监控系统事件、消息服务MNS队列或消息服务MNS主题接收消息通知。当伸缩组发生指定类型的伸缩事件或者资源变化时，弹性伸缩会通知云监控或消息服务。

- 同一个伸缩组内的不同事件通知不可重复使用同一个接收端。

  例如，不同的事件通知不能同时使用同一个云监控、同一个MNS主题或者同一个MNS队列。
descriptions.en:
## Operation description

- You can configure CloudMonitor system events, Message Service (MNS) queues, or MNS topics to receive notifications. When a specified type of scaling event or resource change occurs in a scaling group, Auto Scaling sends notifications to CloudMonitor or MNS.

- Different event notifications within the same scaling group cannot share the same recipient.

  For example, different event notifications cannot use the same CloudMonitor instance, the same MNS topic, or the same MNS queue.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ess create-notification-configuration --scaling-group-id asg-bp1igpak5ft1flyp0000 --notification-arn acs:mns:cn-beijing:1614568843400000:queue/modifyLifecycleHo0000 --notification-type AUTOSCALING:SCALE_OUT_SUCCESS --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --time-zone UTC+8 --message-encoding PlainText --api-version 2014-08-28 --region cn-hangzhou
